name: pr
description: Pull request review, description, grilling, and feedback-addressing workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Review, describe, grill, and address pull requests.
interface.longDescription: PR provides pull request workflows for GitHub and Codeberg, including focused review modules, PR body description publishing, interactive PR grilling with evidence-backed answers, and review feedback addressing.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $pr:review to review, $pr:describe to draft and publish a PR body, $pr:grill to quiz understanding of a PR with evidence-backed answers, or $pr:address to address review feedback.
